title.en: Offshore Wind Power Platform Ontology for OPTiMAR
title.es: Ontología de Plataforma Eólica Offshore para OPTiMAR

description.en: This ontology describes the components, failures, sensors, and events related to offshore wind platforms.
description.es: Esta ontología describe los componentes, fallos, sensores y eventos relacionados con las plataformas eólicas offshore.

comments.en:
Version 2.3 (2026-07-13) - Wind farms, new sensors/data, and monitoring property reorganization:
    - Added the WindFarm class and the composition hierarchy WindFarm -> WindPowerPlatform -> Turbine/Component
    - Added classes: Inverter (Component), ApparentPowerSensor (ElectricalSensor), RotationalSpeedSensor (Sensor),
      WindData/WindDirectionData/WindSpeedData (Measurement)
    - "monitors" and "monitoredBy" become generic top-level properties; all existing "...Monitors"/"...MonitoredBy"
      properties become subproperties of them
    - Added "actorMonitors" (subproperty of "monitors") for the Actor -> Component/Sensor relationship
    - "isMonitoredBy" renamed to "turbineComponentMonitoredBy" (subproperty of "monitoredBy")
    - Added "measures" as a generic superproperty; all "measures..." properties become subproperties of it
    - Added "measuresWindSpeed" and "measuresWindDirection" (subproperties of "measures", domain Anemometer) linking
      the anemometer to WindSpeedData/WindDirectionData, following the same pattern as measuresYawAngle/measuresPitchAngle
    - Added "isInstalledIn"/"hasInstalled" (sensor-component) and "hasTurbine", "hasPlatform", "hasComponent"
      (wind farm/platform composition) properties
    - Added the "measurementType" data property
    - Consistency fixes: "duration", "pressureLevel", "stressLevel" and "vibrationLevel" are now declared solely as
      owl:ObjectProperty (their qudt:QuantityValue range is a class, not a datatype); removed the double typing of
      "hasGeneratedData"; RotationalSpeedSensor added to the sensor disjointness axiom
comments.es:
Version 2.3 (2026-07-13) - Parques eólicos, nuevos sensores/datos y reorganización de la monitorización:
    - Añadida la clase WindFarm y la jerarquía de composición WindFarm -> WindPowerPlatform -> Turbine/Component
    - Añadidas clases: Inverter (Component), ApparentPowerSensor (ElectricalSensor), RotationalSpeedSensor (Sensor),
      WindData/WindDirectionData/WindSpeedData (Measurement)
    - "monitors" y "monitoredBy" pasan a ser propiedades genéricas de nivel superior; todas las propiedades
      "...Monitors"/"...MonitoredBy" existentes pasan a ser subpropiedades de las mismas
    - Se crea "actorMonitors" (subpropiedad de "monitors") para la relación Actor -> Component/Sensor
    - "isMonitoredBy" se renombra a "turbineComponentMonitoredBy" (subpropiedad de "monitoredBy")
    - Se crea "measures" como superpropiedad genérica; todas las propiedades "measures..." pasan a ser subpropiedades
    - Se crean "measuresWindSpeed" y "measuresWindDirection" (subpropiedades de "measures", dominio Anemometer) para
      enlazar el anemómetro con WindSpeedData/WindDirectionData, siguiendo el mismo patrón que measuresYawAngle/measuresPitchAngle
    - Se crean las propiedades "isInstalledIn"/"hasInstalled" (sensor-componente) y "hasTurbine", "hasPlatform",
      "hasComponent" (composición de parque/plataforma)
    - Añadida la data property "measurementType"
    - Correcciones de consistencia: "duration", "pressureLevel", "stressLevel" y "vibrationLevel" quedan declaradas
      únicamente como owl:ObjectProperty (su rango qudt:QuantityValue es una clase, no un tipo de dato); se elimina
      la doble tipificación de "hasGeneratedData"; RotationalSpeedSensor se añade al axioma de disjunción de sensores

abstract.value: Ontología que modela los elementos estructurales, sensores, eventos y fallos de plataformas eólicas offshore, incluyendo datos de medición, actores involucrados y relaciones semánticas entre componentes. Compatible con SOSA para observaciones y QUDT para unidades de medida.

Ontology modeling structural elements, sensors, events, and failures in floating offshore wind platforms, including measurement data, involved actors, and semantic relationships between components. Compatible with SOSA for observations and QUDT for units of measure.
